detail.abstract: China's unprecedented expansion of higher education in 1999, increased annual college enrollment from 1 million to 9.6 million by 2020. We trace the global ripple effects of that expansion by examining its impact on US graduate education and local economies surrounding college towns. Combining administrative data from China's college admissions system and US visa data, we leverage the centralized quota system governing Chinese college admissions for identification and present three key findings. First, the expansion of Chinese undergraduate education drove graduate student flows to the US: every additional 100 college graduates in China led to 3.6 Chinese graduate students in the US. Second, Chinese master's students generated positive spillovers, driving the birth of new master's programs, and increasing the number of other international and American master's students, particularly in STEM fields. And third, the influx of international students supported local economies around college towns, raising job creation rates outside the universities, as well. Our findings highlight how domestic education policy in one country can reshape the academic and economic landscape of another through student migration and its broader spillovers.

detail.title: In Vino Veritas: Reassessing the Price-Taste Relationship in Wine Consumption
detail.abstract: Previous research on how price and branding influence wine perception has yielded inconclusive results, largely due to the subjective and context-dependent nature of taste. This article presents two experimental studies investigating whether stated wine prices affect perceived quality. Results indicate that consumer evaluations were largely independent of price cues and instead shaped by personal preferences, prior experience, and contextual factors. These findings challenge assumptions about the primacy of external cues in shaping taste perceptions and underscore the limitations of relying solely on quantitative methods. We argue for a mixed-methods approach in future wine consumer research, where qualitative data serve not as supplementary, but as integral to experimental design and interpretation. Such integration enhances ecological validity, offers deeper insight into consumer behaviour, and strengthens the applicability of findings in marketing, product development, and alcohol-related public health strategies.

detail.abstract: This paper examines how cooperative coordination shapes vertical competition in U.S. dairy markets. Large cooperatives both sell raw milk to independent processors and compete with them downstream, creating incentives to raise rivals' costs. Exploiting herd retirements under the Herd Retirement Program (HRP) as plausibly supply shocks, I estimate a structural model linking flexible demand curvature to supply conduct. The results show that cooperatives sustain the highest upstream margins and that HRP rounds raised input markups by 3-7%. Consequently, consumers faced higher retail prices due to 54% pass-through rate for processors. These findings show how cooperative coordination enabled a raising-rivals'-costs strategy that redistributed surplus upstream while raising prices on consumers. * Email address: agrawal.158[at]osu[dot]edu. detail.title: The Impact of Text Sentiment-Rating Inconsistency on Consumers' Purchase Decisions
detail.abstract: Consumers frequently refer to online reviews to reduce uncertainty and form expectations about products. But what happens when the signals from a review conflict? This study examines how textrating inconsistency (TRI) in user-generated reviews affects consumer purchase decisions and how this effect varies with user-generated images. Drawing on expectation-confirmation theory, we propose that consumers infer overall sentiment from numerical ratings and that they experience disconfirmation when the accompanying text diverges. Our findings reveal that TRI significantly reduces purchase likelihood, with the effect amplified when images are present. Interestingly, the negative effect is less pronounced for products with inherently low uncertainty, such as one-size-fits-all items. This study advances the literature on user-generated content by highlighting the interplay among review elements and extends expectation-confirmation theory to the online review consumption context. The findings also offer practical implications for e-commerce platforms in managing user-generated content more effectively to improve consumers' shopping experience.

detail.title: Preparing Technology Managers for the Post-Consumer Reviews Era
detail.abstract: Online consumer reviews have long been instrumental in shaping user behavior and guiding product development. However, their credibility, and thus their utility, is in steep decline due to threats such as malicious reviews, incentivized reviews, and AI-generated reviews. As synthetic content becomes indistinguishable from genuine feedback and bad actors exploit platforms to manipulate perceptions, the foundational trust in user-generated reviews is rapidly eroding. This paper explores the critical challenges facing review ecosystems and argues that technology managers must prepare for a transition beyond traditional reviews. It examines how alternative mechanisms, such as question-and-answer systems, expert editorial content, and synthetically generated summaries from aggregated sources, can provide more trustworthy, actionable insights. These alternatives emphasize verified engagement, structured expertise, and scalable synthesis, offering resilient feedback models. The paper calls for a rethinking of how platforms collect, interpret, and present user reviews, outlining practical steps for managers to sustain trust and transparency in digital marketplaces.

title: State-Induction: A Universal Law Governing Information Flow and Behavioral Change in AI Systems

detail.title: State-Induction: A Universal Law Governing Information Flow and Behavioral Change in AI Systems
detail.abstract: When a user tells a conversational AI "My favorite color is blue," the system's behavior changes-yet no training occurs, weights remain frozen, and no gradient descent takes place. We lack a formal theory explaining how information induces behavioral change in AI systems at inference time. We introduce state-induction theory, formalized as a quantitative law: B = σ∇S, where B is behavioral change (KL divergence of output distributions), σ is architectural conductivity (capacity to incorporate information), and ∇S is state gradient (informational potential). We derive this relationship from first principles and generate three falsifiable predictions: (P1) adaptation speed scales as 1/σ, (P2) behavioral change correlates linearly with information strength when σ is fixed, and (P3) the law enables quantitative bottleneck diagnosis. Across 284 data points spanning diverse architectures and tasks, we validate all predictions with correlation r > 0.94 and prediction error < 8%. The law unifies apparently disparate phenomena under one framework: in-context learning (examples provide ∇S, attention provides σ), retrieval-augmented generation (retrieval increases σ from ~0.30 to ~0.85), hallucination (occurs when σ is low despite adequate ∇S), and prompt engineering (increases ∇S through better task specification). State-induction provides quantitative principles for AI systems design, enabling architects to predict performance (B = σ∇S), diagnose failures (measure σ and ∇S independently), and optimize systematically (maximize σ subject to cost constraints). Just as Ohm's law transformed electrical engineering from empiricism to predictive science, state-induction establishes a foundation for principled AI systems engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了状态诱导理论，形式化为B = σ∇S定律，解释AI系统在推理时如何通过信息诱导行为改变，无需训练或权重更新。该理论统一了上下文学习、检索增强生成、幻觉等现象，并在284个数据点上验证了预测准确性。
AI.research_question: AI系统在推理时如何通过信息诱导行为改变？

AI.theoretical_framework: 状态诱导理论，形式化为B = σ∇S定律，其中B是行为改变（输出分布的KL散度），σ是架构电导率（整合信息的能力），∇S是状态梯度（信息势能）。
AI.method: 从第一原理推导状态诱导定律，生成三个可证伪预测，并在284个数据点上验证，涵盖多样化架构和任务。
AI.findings: 验证了所有三个预测：适应速度与1/σ成比例，行为改变与信息强度线性相关，该定律支持定量瓶颈诊断。相关系数r > 0.94，预测误差 < 8%。
AI.theory_contributions: 统一了上下文学习、检索增强生成、幻觉和提示工程等看似不同的现象，为AI系统工程建立了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI系统设计提供定量原则，使架构师能够预测性能、诊断故障并系统优化，类似于欧姆定律对电气工程的变革作用。

title: The Effect of Gender-Aware Curation Algorithms on User Engagement in User-Generated Content Platforms
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS), National University of Singapore (NUS), New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business and The Chinese University of Hong Kong

detail.title: The Effect of Gender-Aware Curation Algorithms on User Engagement in User-Generated Content Platforms
detail.abstract: Although gender-aware curation algorithms (i.e., incorporating users' gender data for content curation or recommendation) have been increasingly adopted, their effects on user engagement in user-generated content (UGC) platforms remain unclear. In this work, we collaborated with a leading short-video platform in Asia to conduct a large-scale randomized experiment by assigning about 400,000 users to either a gender-aware or gender-neutral algorithm for ranking comments. We examined engagement outcomes for comment consumption (i.e., browsing duration) and comment production (i.e., posting incidence). Our findings show that gender-aware curation (relative to gender-neutral approach) increased the average browsing duration of comments by 1.0%. Intriguingly, it had asymmetric effects on comment production where female users (who were 25% less likely to comment than males) increased their commenting likelihood by 2.6%, whereas male users were 3.5% less likely to do so, underscoring the increased gender diversity in online user engagement due to gender-aware curation. Mechanism analyses suggest that the heterogeneous effects originate from differing engagement motives: male users aim to assert individual perspectives for self-presentation purposes, whereas female users are motivated by a desire for community belonging. In sum, our results show that gender-aware curation algorithms can boost user engagement and foster gender diversity of online discussions on UGC platforms. This study underscores the importance of incorporating gender data into curation algorithms, contributes theoretically to research on curation algorithms, user engagement, and gender-based behavioral differences, and offers practical insights for platform managers to design more engaging UGC platforms.

title: The Digital Social Contract: Protecting Identity in the Age of AI

detail.title: The Digital Social Contract: Protecting Identity in the Age of AI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None. The author declares no financial or personal relationships with any organizations or individuals that could have influenced this work. This research was conducted independently without external funding or institutional support.

detail.abstract: What is needed is a new Digital Social Contract. Following Rousseau, legitimacy must rest on the will of the people; and like Bach's harmonies, true stability requires multiple voices in dialogue-governments, citizens, and civil society. Only through democratic oversight, advocacy, and adaptive regulation can digital IDs serve as tools of empowerment rather than instruments of control. Key Policy Takeaway: Digital IDs are inevitable. The question is not if, but how. To protect citizens, strengthen sovereignty, and preserve democracy, governments must embed digital identity within a Digital Social Contract that balances efficiency with freedom, and technology with humanity. Methodology This policy analysis employs a multidisciplinary approach combining political philosophy, comparative case analysis, and technological assessment. The framework draws on: 1. Theoretical analysis grounded in social contract theory (Rousseau, 1762) and contemporary digital governance literature (Zuboff, 2019; Floridi, 2014) 2. Comparative case study methodology examining democratic (Estonia) and authoritarian (China) implementations, as well as mixed systems (India) 3. Document analysis of policy frameworks (GDPR, Aadhaar Act) and technical standards (W3C DIDs, zero-knowledge proofs) 4. Critical engagement with counter-arguments from privacy advocates and technological solutionists This approach allows for both normative claims about democratic governance and empirical observations about existing systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出需要建立新的数字社会契约，主张数字身份系统必须基于人民意志，通过民主监督、倡导和适应性监管，使数字身份成为赋权工具而非控制手段。

title: Digital Transformation in Retail: RFID and Information Systems Capabilities in Zara and Walmart

detail.title: Digital Transformation in Retail: RFID and Information Systems Capabilities in Zara and Walmart
detail.abstract:
Information systems (IS) play a significant role in the retail industry’s rapid digital transformation, providing excellent supply chain agility, efficiency, and consumer responsiveness. This study analyzed two leading retail brands, Zara and Walmart, to discover how radio-frequency identification (RFID) and related information systems capabilities are applied in their fast-fashion and mass retail industries. 

This study also investigates how RFID and cloud-based platforms act as valuable strategic resources that are difficult to copy (Wade & Hulland, 2004) and enable companies to sense and reconfigure market volatility (Teece, 2007). 

The case study demonstrates that Zara achieved excellent inventory accuracy, reduced product cycles, and increased responsiveness by utilizing RFID (Sambamurthy, Bharadwaj, & Grover, 2003). On the other hand, Walmart also uses RFID and IoT devices to improve the efficiency, transparency, and scalability of its logistics network (Kay, 2022). The study demonstrates how IS digital technologies help improve competitive logics in different retail industries by comparing these two models.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析Zara和Walmart如何应用RFID及相关信息系统能力，探讨这些技术如何作为难以复制的战略资源，帮助企业在快时尚和大众零售行业中提升竞争力。

title: Predicting Students' Final Grades using Machine Learning
affiliations: University of the Cumberlands (formerly Cumberland College)

detail.title: Predicting Students' Final Grades using Machine Learning
detail.abstract: This study examines the application of machine learning techniques, specifically linear regression and Random Forest Regression, to predict the final grades of secondary school students using the UCI Student Performance dataset. Through comprehensive data preprocessing, exploratory analysis, and supervised modeling, the project demonstrates that prior academic performance (G1 and G2) serves as the strongest predictor of outcomes (G3). Random Forest consistently outperformed Linear Regression, particularly on the mathematics dataset, achieving an R² above 0.81 with an RMSE within two grade points on a 20-point scale. Beyond methodological insights, the research underscores the practical value of predictive analytics for educational institutions, enabling early intervention strategies, resource optimization, and equitable student support. Moreover, by situating predictive modeling within broader enterprise risk management (ERM) frameworks, the study highlights the importance of integrating educational analytics with organizational risk strategies to proactively address dropout risks and improve learning outcomes. These findings extend the literature on educational data mining and position predictive modeling as a key enabler of data-driven, risk-aware educational policy and practice.

title: "The U.S. Crypto Regulation" and Supporting Documentation, Remarks Before 11th Fintech Conference, Universite Du Luxembourg, October 8, 2025

detail.title: "The U.S. Crypto Regulation" and Supporting Documentation, Remarks Before 11th Fintech Conference, Universite Du Luxembourg, October 8, 2025
detail.abstract: The Great American financial Depression of the 1930s created a need for regulatory reform and resulted in creation of such new regulatory frameworks as the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Since then, the purpose of the SEC has been to create and nurture efficient securities markets enabling efficient and robust capital formation while preventing fraud upon the investing public. It is Donald Trump's November 2024 election as U.S. president that results in the most dramatic philosophical change to governmental regulation in over ninety years. The following pages are based on my prepared remarks before the 11 th Fintech Conference, Universite Du Luxembourg, Luxembourg, October 8, 2025. Having been asked to comment on crypto regulation in the United States, my comments and focus, as requested, is the regulation of crypto currencies, protection of the investing public, and their impact on the soundness of capital markets and our financial system. These remarks were given at a time when the U.S. Congress was purposefully not in Washington to conduct business, the U.S. government was "shut down" since October 1, 2025 having failed to authorize required funding, and thousands of federal government workers were being permanently terminated from employment. Congressional passage of the GENIUS Act (stablecoin) legislation during the summer of 2025, suggests, however uncertain, that cryptocurrencies have a significant future in the United States. These issues are the subject of this paper.

title: Turning Data into Decisions: The National Biodiversity Protection Index
affiliations: and

detail.title: Turning Data into Decisions: The National Biodiversity Protection Index
detail.abstract: The accelerating erosion of global biodiversity demands rigorous, internationally comparable evaluation of national conservation performance. This paper introduces the National Biodiversity Protection Index (NBPI), a composite, evidence-based framework structured around three complementary dimensions: Stock, capturing intrinsic ecological endowment and ecosystem integrity; Pressure, representing anthropogenic and natural stressors on ecosystems; and Response, reflecting the policy, regulatory, and management effort devoted to protection. Grounded in the State-Pressure-Response tradition, the NBPI operationalizes a transparent quantitative pipeline that assembles indicators from authoritative sources, harmonizes heterogeneous measures, and aggregates them into dimension scores and an overall index suitable for crosscountry and overtime benchmarking. The design emphasizes reproducibility, clear indicator provenance, and methodological transparency to support policy uptake and academic scrutiny. Applied globally, the NBPI differentiates higher-performing nations-characterized by stronger conservation frameworks and lower ecosystem pressures-from those where elevated threats coincide with weaker protective capacity, thereby providing a clear baseline for tracking biodiversity protection commitments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了国家生物多样性保护指数（NBPI），这是一个基于证据的复合框架，用于评估各国生物多样性保护绩效。该指数包含Stock（生态禀赋）、Pressure（生态压力）和Response（保护响应）三个维度，通过透明量化方法整合权威指标，为跨国和跨时间比较提供基准。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个严谨、可国际比较的国家生物多样性保护绩效评估框架？
AI.motivation: 全球生物多样性加速丧失，需要建立严谨、可国际比较的国家保护绩效评估体系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于状态-压力-响应（State-Pressure-Response）理论框架。
AI.method: 开发NBPI复合指数，整合权威数据源指标，通过透明量化流程进行指标标准化和聚合。
AI.findings: NBPI能够区分保护绩效较高的国家（具有更强保护框架和更低生态压力）与保护绩效较低的国家（生态威胁高但保护能力弱）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将状态-压力-响应理论框架操作化为可量化的生物多样性保护评估指数。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供可复制的评估工具，支持生物多样性保护承诺的跟踪和比较。

title: From Blacklists to Bankruptcy: The Impact of Personal Insolvency Frameworks on Startups
affiliations: Shanghai University of Economics and Finance, Peking University - China Center for Economic Research (CCER), Shanghai University of Finance and Economics, South China University of Technology, Shanghai University of Finance and Economics and Shanghai University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: From Blacklists to Bankruptcy: The Impact of Personal Insolvency Frameworks on Startups
detail.abstract: This paper studies the economic impact of introducing a personal bankruptcy regime in an emerging market context, using China's recent pilot reforms as a natural experiment. We exploit the staggered rollout of personal bankruptcy frameworks across Chinese cities and construct a novel dataset of bankruptcy case filings, combined with survey-based measures of credit access and official firm registration records. Our difference-in-differences estimates show that the reforms significantly improve small business credit access - business loan take-up increases by 1.3 percentage points (21% relative to pre-reform mean), with no offsetting rise in interest rates. Effects are concentrated among non-corporate firms, firms with less employees and female entrepreneurs, consistent with the role of bankruptcy protection as a form of wealth insurance. Moreover, we observe a 9.7% increase in new firm registrations, driven primarily by sole proprietors but also present among corporate entities, likely due to widespread use of personal guarantees. To interpret these findings, we develop a simple but novel theoretical model in which personal bankruptcy reduces the downside risk of entrepreneurial failure while preserving creditor recoveries. These findings underscore how debtor protection policies, when designed to reduce enforcement costs without expanding exemption rights, can enhance credit supply and entrepreneurial activity without inducing creditor flight or moral hazard.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用中国个人破产试点改革作为自然实验，发现个人破产制度显著改善了小微企业信贷获取，商业贷款使用率提高1.3个百分点，新企业注册增加9.7%，且未导致利率上升或债权人退出。
AI.research_question: 引入个人破产制度对新兴市场小微企业信贷获取和创业活动有何经济影响？
AI.motivation: 研究个人破产制度在发展中国家环境下的经济效应，填补现有文献主要关注发达国家的空白，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建了一个新颖的理论模型，认为个人破产通过降低创业失败的下行风险（财富保险功能）同时保持债权人回收率，能够促进信贷供给和创业活动。
AI.method: 利用中国城市个人破产框架交错实施的准自然实验，采用双重差分法，结合破产案件申报数据、信贷获取调查和企业注册记录构建新数据集。
AI.findings: 改革显著改善小微企业信贷获取（商业贷款使用率提高21%），新企业注册增加9.7%，效果集中在非公司制企业、小企业和女性创业者，且未出现利率上升。

AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场国家设计个人破产制度提供政策启示，证明合理的债务人保护政策能够促进信贷供给和创业活力，而不会损害债权人利益。

title: Leadership and Coordination in Human-AI Hybrid Teams: A Distributed Agency Approach
affiliations: UCL School of Management, University College London

detail.title: Leadership and Coordination in Human-AI Hybrid Teams: A Distributed Agency Approach
detail.abstract: Facing rapid development in AI technologies, organizations are under competitive pressure to deploy these technologies. How to leverage AI technologies for augmenting rather than displacing human collaboration? I develop a distributed agency approach to human-AI collaboration—a human acting through multiple AI agents that embody their knowledge and preferences to different degrees. These agents, endowed with varying decision rights across different domains, reduce friction and bias in human collaboration by intermediating interactions. This article (1) delineates three tunable dimensions in deploying these representatives— fidelity, autonomy, and scope; (2) theorizes conditions under which this approach improves team coordination and performance; (3) identifies interventions that buffer potential loss in human willingness and capacity to collaborate. I aim to advance research and practice on human-AI collaboration and hybrid intelligence by moving beyond inter-individual coordination to incorporate intra-individual coordination (i.e., among an individual’s AI agents) and by embedding authenticity and accountability as key features of human–AI teaming.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了分布式代理方法来实现人机协作，通过多个AI代理代表人类在不同领域进行决策，减少协作摩擦和偏见。

detail.abstract: Problems related to the extremization of functions have been studied for quite a long time not only by Russian experts but also by the world's leading experts in the field of applied mathematics. It should be noted that, nowadays, not all problems on this topic have a solution, despite the ongoing active research in mathematical modeling and mathematical programming. A serious work is underway on a deeper study of the properties of extremizable functions. This is especially topical in the context of our country's transition to a knowledge economy and, as a first step towards this, to the digital economy, when powerful supercomputers with performance of hundreds and thousands of petaflops have arisen and quantum computers begin to occur. The paper is a survey of results associated with a new class of functions that are useful in extremization problems and is based on joint work of the authors.

title: Development Banks in Turbulent Times: Lending Behaviour across the cycle
affiliations: University of Milan, University of Milan, University of Milan and University of Milan

detail.title: Development Banks in Turbulent Times: Lending Behaviour across the cycle
detail.abstract: ​Development banks (DBs) are increasingly called upon to play a crucial role in modern economies, including a fundamental stabilising function in times of crisis. Yet, systematic evidence on their lending behaviour across the business cycle remains limited. This paper provides the first global empirical assessment of the cyclicality of DBs compared to commercial banks (CBs) and clarifies the conditions under which they fulfil their function. We construct a novel dataset covering 255 DBs and 3,706 CBs across more than 100 countries over the period 2006–2023. Our analysis reveals that DBs are, on average, significantly less cyclical than CBs, a trend that is particularly evident during crises, including banking crises and the COVID-19 pandemic. The effect is highly heterogeneous: first, regional DBs are less cyclical than national and multinational DBs; second, their lending is particularly resilient compared to that of small, private, and highly capitalised CBs; and third, in countries with weaker supervisory frameworks. Notably, DBs outperform large and state-owned CBs in sustaining credit during downturns, confirming that their lending behaviour is driven by their public mission, rather than size or ownership. Importantly, sustaining lending in adverse phases does not come at the expense of loan quality: DBs do not show higher levels of non-performing loans relative to CBs during economic downturns. These findings highlight DBs’ role as effective stabilisers of credit supply and offer new insights into their contribution to financial stability and crisis management.

detail.abstract: The WTO TRIPS Agreement was adopted in Marrakesh on April 15, 1994, and entered into force more than three decades ago. The 30th anniversary of this landmark multilateral agreement provides an ideal juncture for reviewing the instrument in relation to the debate on intellectual property and global justice. To help illuminate this debate, the present chapter focuses on three concepts that can be used in the contexts of the TRIPS Agreement as well as other areas of intellectual property law and policy: (1) just transition, (2) selective adaptation, and (3) enabling environment. Using developments relating to the TRIPS Agreement, this chapter illustrates how these concepts can be utilized to advance the debate on intellectual property and global justice.

title: Conflict, Fear, and Mistrust in Kenya’s 'White Highlands'
affiliations: Nova School of Business & Economics

detail.title: Conflict, Fear, and Mistrust in Kenya’s 'White Highlands'
detail.abstract: Land policy was a key channel for clientelist redistribution in African states during the 20th century. During this period, Kenya's Rift Valley was twice transformed by land policies: first by the colonial era `White Highlands', and later by independence era `Settlement Schemes'. Meanwhile, in recent times Kenya has periodically seen civil conflict along ethnic lines, with links drawn to historical land issues. I test these links by examining for the long-run effects of exposure to historical land policies on conflict, fear, and mistrust. I find that in the White Highlands trust in neighbors is lower and fear of election-related violence is higher, while in the Settlement Schemes trust in both neighbors and relatives is higher and support for political violence is lower. My results are supported by analysis decomposing estimates by distance from the White Highlands and are robust to various sample adjustments. detail.abstract: This study examines the effect of idiosyncratic risk on the green innovation of A-share listed companies in China from 2010-2021, using idiosyncratic risk as a proxy for financial risk. Results indicate that idiosyncratic risk adversely affects a firm's green innovation, which is negatively moderated by heightened economic policy uncertainty (EPU), highlighting that firms tend to defer or halt green innovation investments under high EPU, appreciating the 'real option' value of a decision to 'wait-and-see'. Further, policy determinant analysis reveals that the negative moderation originates from trade-related policy uncertainties. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the primary findings are more pronounced in non-SOEs and those companies determined to be larger, older, and more leveraged firms with elevated ESG performance. Findings are found to be robust across several various econometric approaches. This research contributes to the literature on corporate green innovation by analysing the moderating role of EPU and providing insights for managers, investors, and policymakers.

detail.abstract: Algorithmic trading has transformed modern financial markets, leveraging computational power to execute trades with speed and precision. However, traditional rule-based strategies often struggle with the dynamic and non-stationary nature of financial environments. This paper investigates the application of Reinforcement Learning (RL) to develop adaptive, data-driven trading strategies that optimize trade execution and manage risk. We propose a modular RL framework that integrates market state representation, reward engineering, and policy optimization. Using real-world market data, we evaluate our models on multiple metrics including Sharpe ratio, drawdown, and execution cost. detail.abstract: Insider trading is a persistent threat to financial market integrity, where privileged information is exploited for illegal profit. Traditional detection systems rely heavily on supervised learning and static models that struggle to adapt to complex, evolving financial relationships and dynamic market conditions. This paper proposes a novel approach using Graph Reinforcement Learning (Graph RL) to detect insider trading. We model the financial ecosystem as a dynamic, heterogeneous graph capturing interactions among traders, companies, and regulators. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) learn rich, relational embeddings, while a Reinforcement Learning (RL) agent is trained to identify anomalous trading behavior by optimizing reward signals derived from ground truth data, regulatory feedback, and historical market trends. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate superior detection performance, adaptability to evolving behaviors, and strong interpretability, particularly in identifying subtle and complex patterns indicative of insider trading activities across time, different market conditions, and a wide range of trading strategies. The approach also provides enhanced scalability to handle large-scale financial networks, ensuring its applicability to diverse and high-frequency trading environments. Our approach presents a promising and scalable path for intelligent, real-time financial fraud detection, offering a significant improvement over conventional methods that fail to keep up with the dynamic nature of financial markets.

title: A Deterministic Derivation of the Fluctuation-Dissipation Relation from the Deviation-Energy Balance

detail.title: A Deterministic Derivation of the Fluctuation-Dissipation Relation from the Deviation-Energy Balance
detail.abstract: A geometric and deterministic generalization of the fluctuation–dissipation relation (GFDR) is derived directly from the deviation–energy balance of linear stochastic systems. Starting from the stochastic differential equation dz = (A z + f(t)) dt + Q dWₜ, the mean-square energy EΔ = ½ zᵀ H z satisfies d/dt E[EΔ] = − E[Σ] + E[Π_det] + Π_noise, where Σ = zᵀ S_H z represents irreversible dissipation, Π_det = zᵀ H f(t) deterministic power input, and Π_noise = ½ tr(H Q Qᵀ) stochastic power injection. At statistical steady state this yields the balance law E[Σ] = E[Π_det] + Π_noise, valid for any finite-dimensional stable linear system independent of equilibrium or ensemble assumptions. When the Einstein relation H Q Qᵀ = 2 k_B T S_H is imposed, the classical fluctuation–dissipation theorem follows as a special case. The result provides a deterministic structure linking dissipation, external drive, and fluctuation within a single algebraic framework applicable to both equilibrium and nonequilibrium regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文从线性随机系统的偏差-能量平衡出发，推导出了一个几何且确定性的涨落-耗散关系（GFDR）的推广形式。该关系在统计稳态下建立了耗散、确定性功率输入和随机功率注入之间的平衡定律，适用于有限维稳定线性系统，无需平衡或系综假设。当施加爱因斯坦关系时，经典的涨落-耗散定理作为特例出现。

AI.method: 从随机微分方程dz = (A z + f(t)) dt + Q dWₜ出发，推导均方能量EΔ = ½ zᵀ H z的演化方程，分析统计稳态下的能量平衡关系
AI.findings: 在统计稳态下建立了平衡定律E[Σ] = E[Π_det] + Π_noise，其中Σ表示不可逆耗散，Π_det为确定性功率输入，Π_noise为随机功率注入。该关系适用于任何有限维稳定线性系统，无需平衡或系综假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了几何且确定性的涨落-耗散关系推广形式；2) 建立了统一的代数框架，同时适用于平衡和非平衡体系；3) 经典涨落-耗散定理成为该框架的特例

title: Analyzing the Impact of a New Battery Factory on Local Housing Prices: Evidence from Skellefteå, Sweden

detail.title: Analyzing the Impact of a New Battery Factory on Local Housing Prices: Evidence from Skellefteå, Sweden
detail.abstract: In October 2017, Northvolt AB, a Swedish lithium-ion battery manufacturer, announced the construction of Northvolt Ett, Europe's largest lithium-ion battery factory, in the northern Swedish municipality of Skellefteå. The estimated investment until 2023 was up to €4 billion, providing 3,000 new jobs to the local town. Many articles have been written about the subsequent increase in housing prices in Skellefteå, focusing on both economic revitalization and the subsequent increase in housing prices. This paper uses synthetic control and synthetic difference-in-differences (DiD) methods to investigate the effect of the announcement of factory establishment on local housing prices. To estimate a treatment effect, both models produce a synthetic counterfactual of housing price development in Skellefteå using a donor pool of municipalities selected for their similarity based on socioeconomic factors. The counterfactual was constructed and the analysis was completed using the Synth (Abadie et al., 2011) and Synthdid (Arkhangelsky et al., 2021) packages in R. Our Synthetic Control models estimate that as of 2021, Northvolt Ett increased apartment valuations by 36.6% or 6,822 (SEK/m²), and house K/T (price/taxable value) ratios by 18.4% (0.42), both estimates considered statistically significant. This allows us to reject our null hypothesis. Our synthetic DiD model produces positive estimates without statistical significance. We note that due to the lack of median income data for 2022, our synthetic control models only extend to 2021. Given the trend in housing prices in Skellefteå in comparison to Synthetic Skellefteå, we believe there is a high probability of observing higher treatment estimates for 2022.

detail.abstract: Using the exogeneous change in sunset exposures at U.S. time zone borders in a geographic regression discontinuity setting, we find that municipalities with later sunsets have lower borrowing costs, despite being at greater risk of adverse long-term health and labor market outcomes due to social jet lag. We confirm this effect using a daylight savings time policy shock and show that it is concentrated in short-term bonds. We argue that this mispricing is driven by local retail investors who disproportionately hold short-term municipal bonds and are more likely to overweight salient economic signals. In line with our theory of retail investor myopia, we show that residents in late sunset areas engage more in local consumption, leading to higher sales tax revenue despite no difference in total revenue. Finally, we find that the estimated economic costs of social jet lag exceed the consumption-based fiscal benefits, reinforcing the interpretation that bond pricing fails to fully reflect long-term risks.

detail.abstract: Imagine this, in the heart of every Indian home, there is a particular story through which each family has a unique familiarity. Now in a particular house there is a joint family, the kids are playing, the retirees are sitting wondering about the next bill, the earning class are working from their pc's and in the corner of this house is a family accountant, who is folding ledgers and putting coins in a sturdy box called pensions. But over time this box gathers dust with no one to put anything in it because everything is invested elsewhere. Gold rings, property deeds, the property market while the box, promising security for the future, stays stubbornly empty. This is the very puzzle at the core of the Indian pension story. Despite various reforms, awareness drives, regulatory innovations why do most Indians still prefer the old financial comforts over the official pension system championed by the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA). With an aging population such as in India and shrinking traditional safety nets, the stakes could not be higher, millions are risking an uncertain retirement and the question still looms, why do so few trust this sturdy savings box and what can be done to change their minds? In this paper, we'll follow the journey of India's pension schemes, the evolving role of PFRDA, and most importantly, the everyday stories and behaviours that keep the savings box locked. Our goal: to unravel the human side of policy, with a blend of data, narrative, and voices from India's young, old, and in-between.

detail.title: Exploring Gender and Racial Disparities in Mortgage Pricing: A Comprehensive Analysis of Risk-Based Lending Practices
detail.abstract: This study investigates whether risk-based mortgage pricing exhibits gender and racial neutrality, using a nationally representative dataset from the National Survey of Mortgage Originations (2013–2020). We apply exact matching, propensity score matching, and interaction regression models to isolate the influence of borrower demographics on interest rate spreads and default outcomes. Our analysis reveals that women consistently face higher mortgage costs than men with similar financial profiles, despite showing equal or lower default risk. Racial disparities are more nuanced: Black and Hispanic borrowers experience higher loan costs and default rates, yet rate spread differences largely disappear after financial controls—except for Asian borrowers, who consistently receive more favorable terms. Interaction effects confirm that financial variables influence pricing differently across demographic groups, and residual analysis highlights persistent unexplained pricing gaps, especially by gender. These findings suggest the presence of systemic bias in algorithmic pricing, reinforcing the need for more equitable and transparent lending models.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用2013-2020年全国抵押贷款发放调查数据，发现基于风险的抵押贷款定价存在性别和种族差异。女性面临更高的抵押贷款成本，尽管违约风险与男性相当或更低。种族差异更为复杂，黑人、西班牙裔借款人成本更高，而亚洲借款人获得更优惠条款。研究揭示了算法定价中的系统性偏见。
AI.research_question: 基于风险的抵押贷款定价是否表现出性别和种族中立性？
AI.motivation: 探究抵押贷款市场中是否存在系统性的人口统计学偏见，特别是在算法定价日益普及的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险的定价理论、公平贷款理论、算法偏见理论
AI.method: 使用全国代表性数据集，应用精确匹配、倾向得分匹配和交互回归模型来分离借款人人口统计特征对利率利差和违约结果的影响
AI.findings: 1) 女性比财务状况相似的男性面临更高的抵押贷款成本，尽管违约风险相当或更低；2) 黑人和西班牙裔借款人贷款成本和违约率更高，但利率利差差异在财务控制后基本消失（亚洲借款人除外）；3) 财务变量对不同人口群体的定价影响存在差异；4) 残差分析显示存在持续无法解释的定价差距，特别是性别差距

detail.title: Dynamic Incentives for Venture Capitalists to Screen Investment Projects
detail.abstract: We develop a continuous-time principal–agent model where venture capitalists' (VCs) unobservable and costly screening effort persistently influences project output subject to stochastic shocks. We derive the optimal contract and implement it with a claim similar to a perpetual knock-in option granted to VC. We provide a theoretical rationale for the widespread hurdle rate provisions. If principal and agent are equally patient, the contract is explicit and achieves first-best optimality. We extend the model to incorporate monitoring incentives where VC keeps a fraction of equity and dividends are paid only when project output crosses a time- and state-dependent line from below.

detail.title: Business Cycle Fluctuations and Monetary Policy under Heterogeneous Information: A Literature Review

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss National Bank Working Paper No. 16/2025

detail.abstract: Modelling business cycle fluctuations and the nonneutrality of money is an ongoing challenge for macroeconomists. While the imperfect-information hypothesis developed by Phelps and Lucas in the 1970s had been abandoned in favour of the sticky-price hypothesis, a recent trend in the literature has put the imperfect-information hypothesis back on the agenda to explain business fluctuations and monetary nonneutrality. The success of this revival lies in the introduction of strategic uncertainty into a framework of heterogeneous information. The present paper presents this macroeconomic framework and provides a brief overview of recent advances in the literature.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了宏观经济学中关于经济周期波动和货币非中性的研究，重点讨论了不完全信息假说的复兴及其在解释经济波动和货币非中性方面的作用。

AI.motivation: 模拟经济周期波动和货币非中性是宏观经济学家面临的持续挑战。虽然Phelps和Lucas在1970年代提出的不完全信息假说曾被粘性价格假说取代，但近期文献趋势重新将不完全信息假说提上议程。

title: Dual-Currency Systems and Inflation Control: A Novel Approach to Universal Basic Income Implementation
affiliations: and Anthropic

detail.title: Dual-Currency Systems and Inflation Control: A Novel Approach to Universal Basic Income Implementation
detail.abstract: This paper examines Creative Currency Octaves (CCO), a dual-currency monetary framework designed to implement Universal Basic Income while mitigating inflationary pressures. Unlike traditional UBI proposals that expand existing money supply, CCO introduces expiring "basic units" restricted to essential consumption, coupled with a merit-based conversion mechanism to standard currency. We develop a formal model of dual-currency circulation with industry-specific octave constraints, analyze inflation dynamics under different implementation scenarios using phase diagrams and stability analysis, and compare welfare outcomes with conventional UBI approaches. Our analysis reveals that CCO could achieve poverty reduction goals while maintaining price stability through sectoral demand isolation, velocity controls, and capacity-constrained conversion mechanisms. Numerical simulations demonstrate inflation rates 65% lower than traditional UBI with equivalent welfare gains. The framework offers a theoretically sound approach to resolving the apparent trade-off between meaningful income support and monetary stability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出创意货币八度音阶（CCO）双货币框架，通过引入有期限的基本消费单位和基于绩效的转换机制，在实施全民基本收入的同时控制通胀压力。

AI.motivation: 传统UBI方案会扩大货币供应量导致通胀压力，需要找到既能提供有意义的收入支持又能维持货币稳定的解决方案。

AI.method: 开发双货币流通的形式模型，使用相图和稳定性分析不同实施情景下的通胀动态，与传统UBI方法进行福利结果比较

title: When not to use Payments for Ecosystem Services for Conservation: a Choice Experiment in a Deforestation Hotspot of the Brazilian Cerrado

detail.title: When not to use Payments for Ecosystem Services for Conservation: a Choice Experiment in a Deforestation Hotspot of the Brazilian Cerrado

keywords: Payments for Ecosystem Services (PES)Discrete Choice Experiment (DCE)Willingness to Accept (WTA)Conservation incentivesAgricultural frontiers (Cerrado

detail.abstract: Incentivizing conservation in agricultural frontier regions presents complex challenges for long-term effectiveness. This study investigates the potential and limitations of Payments for Ecosystem Services (PES) to prevent legal deforestation of surplus Legal Reserve (LR) areas in MATOPIBA, a rapidly expanding soybean-producing region in Brazil. Using a discrete choice experiment (DCE) with 81 soybean producers who possess native vegetation beyond legal requirements, we estimate willingness-to-accept (WTA) compensation under varying contract attributes—including payment size, permanence requirements, payment structure, and funding institutions. Results from mixed logit and latent class models reveal significant heterogeneity in preferences and motivations. High payments are necessary to engage producers likely to deforest, while low-cost participants often exhibit low ex-ante additionality. The requirement to convert surplus areas into permanent reserves (RPPNs) drastically increases WTA, often exceeding the likely opportunity cost of land. Social influence, especially peer familiarity with PES, significantly reduces compensation demands. Our findings highlight risks of adverse selection, limited permanence, and the illusion of cost-effectiveness when targeting only low-WTA landowners. We conclude that PES programs in agricultural frontier contexts must prioritize targeting, behavioral insight, and complementary strategies - such as land acquisition or peer-based outreach - to achieve meaningful conservation outcomes.

AI.research_question: 生态系统服务付费(PES)在防止农业前沿地区合法森林砍伐方面的潜力和局限性是什么？

AI.theoretical_framework: 生态系统服务付费理论、离散选择实验理论、行为经济学理论
AI.method: 对81名拥有超过法定要求的原生植被的大豆生产者进行离散选择实验，使用混合logit和潜在类别模型分析
AI.findings: 生产者偏好存在显著异质性；高额支付对可能砍伐的生产者至关重要；将剩余区域转为永久保护区大幅增加补偿要求；社会影响显著降低补偿需求；存在逆向选择和有限持久性风险

title: How Does Subnational Variation in Repression Affect Attitudes Toward Police? Evidence From Iraq’s 2019 Protests
affiliations: Duke University School of Law

detail.title: How Does Subnational Variation in Repression Affect Attitudes Toward Police? Evidence From Iraq’s 2019 Protests

publicationDetails.detailsText: Violence: An International Journal, volume 3, issue 1, 2022[10.1177/26330024211070318]

detail.abstract: Recent episodes of severe police repression and violence against protesters around the world have brought new urgency to longstanding calls for police reform and in some cases more fundamental structural changes including abolition of existing police institutions. However, the police are not monolithic and there is considerable subnational variation in the extent to which individual police officers and units use excessive force against civilians, and this variation has important implications for police legitimacy in the eyes of the public. In Iraq, where federal police violently repressed anti-government demonstrations in 2019-killing more than 600 protesters-but local police refrained from violence and in some cases intervened to protect civilians, public opinion became significantly more negative toward federal police but not toward local police. These results suggest that civilians distinguish between the conduct of different actors in a decentralized, fragmented security apparatus and attribute blame individually rather than collectively blaming the state security apparatus as a whole. I suggest that two mechanisms—decentralization and fragmentation of state security institutions—interact to shape the pattern of subnational police violence in Iraq and discuss broader implications for police reform in Iraq and beyond.

AI.tldr: 本文研究伊拉克联邦警察与地方警察在2019年抗议活动中的暴力使用差异，发现公众能够区分不同警察机构的行为，并对联邦警察和地方警察形成不同的态度。

title: Blackwell without Priors
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology - School of Economics

detail.title: Blackwell without Priors
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a fully prior-free model of experimentation in which the decision maker observes the entire distribution of signals generated by a known experiment under an unknown distribution of the state of the world. One experiment is robustly more informative than another if the decision maker's maxmin expected utility after observing the output of the former is always at least her maxmin expected utility after observing the latter. We show that this ranking holds if and only if the less informative experiment is a linear transformation of the more informative experiment; equivalently, the null space of the more informative experiment is a subset of the null space of the less informative experiment. Our criterion is implied by Blackwell's order but does not imply it, and we show by example that our ranking admits strictly more comparable pairs of experiments than the classical ranking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个完全无先验的实验模型，决策者在已知实验但状态分布未知的情况下观察信号分布。一个实验比另一个实验更稳健地信息丰富，如果决策者在观察前者输出后的最大最小期望效用总是至少等于观察后者后的最大最小期望效用。我们证明这种排序成立当且仅当信息较少的实验是信息较多实验的线性变换；等价地，信息较多实验的零空间是信息较少实验零空间的子集。我们的标准被布莱克威尔序所蕴含但不蕴含它，通过例子表明我们的排序允许比经典排序更多的可比较实验对。
AI.research_question: 在完全无先验的实验模型中，如何定义一个实验比另一个实验更稳健地信息丰富？这种排序与经典的布莱克威尔序有何关系？
AI.motivation: 传统的信息比较理论如布莱克威尔序依赖于先验分布，但在许多实际决策问题中，决策者可能没有可靠的先验信息。需要发展一种不依赖先验分布的信息比较框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于最大最小期望效用的稳健决策理论，实验信息性的线性代数特征（零空间包含关系），信息比较的稳健排序理论
AI.method: 理论分析，构建完全无先验的实验模型，通过线性变换和零空间关系定义信息排序，与布莱克威尔序进行比较分析
AI.findings: 一个实验比另一个更稳健地信息丰富当且仅当信息较少的实验是信息较多实验的线性变换，或等价地信息较多实验的零空间是信息较少实验零空间的子集。这种排序被布莱克威尔序蕴含但不蕴含布莱克威尔序，允许更多实验对之间的比较。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了第一个完全无先验的实验信息比较框架，建立了基于零空间包含关系的信息排序新标准，扩展了传统信息比较理论的应用范围
AI.practical_contributions: 为缺乏可靠先验信息的决策问题提供了实用的实验选择标准，在统计决策、实验设计等领域具有广泛应用价值

title: Dynamic Network Effects with Fear of Missing Out
affiliations: Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) - Sao Paulo School of Economics,  and Universidad de los Andes, Chile

detail.title: Dynamic Network Effects with Fear of Missing Out
detail.abstract: We study the dynamics of network goods, such as social media, when agents experience fear of missing out (FOMO): the consumption of a popular product generates negative externalities for those who abstain. We incorporate FOMO into a model of network externalities with timing frictions. FOMO can give rise to product market traps, where agents get stuck consuming a good in equilibrium, but would prefer it not to exist. However, such traps may still be constrained efficient. When an economy is in a trap, large restrictions on social media raise welfare, but small restrictions might lower it. We show how experimental results can be used to assess efficiency through the lens of our model, and using estimates from the empirical literature, we find that TikTok and Instagram are in an inefficient equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了网络商品（如社交媒体）在用户存在错失恐惧症（FOMO）时的动态。FOMO会产生负外部性，导致产品市场陷阱，即用户陷入消费均衡但希望产品不存在。研究发现，当经济处于陷阱时，大规模限制社交媒体能提高福利，但小规模限制可能降低福利。通过实证估计，TikTok和Instagram处于无效率均衡状态。
AI.research_question: 当用户存在错失恐惧症（FOMO）时，网络商品（如社交媒体）的动态如何？FOMO如何影响产品市场均衡和效率？
AI.motivation: 研究FOMO对网络商品消费行为的影响，特别是当流行产品的消费对不使用者产生负外部性时，如何形成产品市场陷阱及其福利影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络外部性理论、错失恐惧症（FOMO）理论、博弈论、均衡分析
AI.method: 构建包含FOMO的网络外部性模型，结合时间摩擦因素，进行理论分析和均衡推导，并利用实证文献估计进行应用分析
AI.findings: FOMO会导致产品市场陷阱，用户陷入消费均衡但希望产品不存在；陷阱可能是约束有效的；大规模限制社交媒体能提高福利，小规模限制可能降低福利；TikTok和Instagram处于无效率均衡
AI.theory_contributions: 将FOMO纳入网络外部性理论框架，揭示了产品市场陷阱的形成机制和福利影响，提供了评估效率的新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于社交媒体监管的指导，帮助识别和解决无效率均衡问题，提高社会福利

detail.title: The Socio-Economic and Environmental Impacts of Untreated Domestic Wastewater in Tirupattur urban limits of Tirupattur District in Tamil Nadu
detail.abstract: The rapid urbanization and population growth in Tirupattur urban centers, a developing urban center in India, have led to significant increases in domestic wastewater generation. This study explores the economic impacts of domestic wastewater on local environmental management systems, highlighting the challenges and financial burdens associated with inadequate wastewater treatment infrastructure. The environmental remediation expenses, as well as indirect costs related to public health, groundwater contamination and ecosystem degradation. Through a combination of field surveys, stakeholder interviews, the research identifies critical inefficiencies in wastewater handling and examines how these inefficiencies strain the financial resources of urban local bodies. Furthermore, the study evaluates the long-term economic consequences of neglecting sustainable wastewater management, including increased healthcare expenditures and reduced economic productivity due to environmental deterioration. This study aligns with multiple United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly SDG 6 (Clean Water and Sanitation) and sustainable urban planning, the research offers policy-level recommendations to reduce economic strain while promoting environmental resilience and sustainable development in Tirupattur.

title: Nature-Based Solutions or Green Taxes? Riparian buffers prevent eutrophication more effectively than taxes on fertilizers
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Wageningen University and Research (WUR), Wageningen University & Research, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Wageningen University

detail.title: Nature-Based Solutions or Green Taxes? Riparian buffers prevent eutrophication more effectively than taxes on fertilizers
detail.abstract: Nutrient pollution from agricultural activities deteriorates water quality, biodiversity, and ecosystem functioning of interconnected terrestrial, aquatic and marine ecosystems. There are many policy instruments aiming to reduce the impact of nutrient eutrophication. However, their effectiveness is seldom compared. We assessed the environmental and economic performance of two policy instruments for controlling phosphorus diffuse pollution from agriculture into riverine systems: the implementation of riparian vegetation buffers and a phosphorus fertilizer tax. We used a spatial explicit model and integrated economic analysis to compare the cost-effectiveness and equity of both interventions using a representative watershed within the Rio de la Plata freshwater system of South America. We found that riparian vegetation buffers achieve substantial reductions in phosphorus exports from land to freshwater systems, while a fertilizer tax yields only marginal environmental benefits. Building on this comparison, we then explored a hybrid scheme in which riparian vegetation buffers are financially incentivized through the revenue generated by a phosphorus fertilizer tax. This combined approach preserves the environmental effectiveness of riparian vegetation buffers while improving distributional outcomes and feasibility by reducing the excessive burden imposed on farmers located near watercourses. Our findings suggest that complementing regulatory measures with targeted environmental taxes can offer a balanced and politically feasible strategy for addressing nutrient pollution in agricultural and ecological ecosystems.

AI.method: 使用空间显式模型和整合经济分析，以南美洲拉普拉塔河流域的代表性流域为案例，比较河岸植被缓冲带和磷肥税两种干预措施。

title: Digitalization and energy consumption in the EU: sector-specific impacts and mediating factors
affiliations: University of Cologne, University of Cologne and Justus-Liebig-Universität Gießen

detail.title: Digitalization and energy consumption in the EU: sector-specific impacts and mediating factors
detail.abstract: This paper examines the relationship between digitalization and final energy and electricity consumption in the EU-28 from 2007 to 2020, with a focus on the industrial, transport, and residential sectors. Utilizing system generalized method of moments (GMM), we explore how the expansion of information and communication technology (ICT) capital impacts sector-specific energy consumption patterns. Our findings reveal that increased digitalization correlates with reductions in overall energy and electricity consumption, with a 10% increase in ICT capital share linked to a decrease of 0.74% in energy consumption and 0.47% in electricity consumption. Sector-specific analyses further demonstrate that digitalization lowers energy consumption in the industry and residential sectors, attributed to economic restructuring and efficiency improvements towards activities with lower energy demand. In the transport sector, the impact of digitalization on energy consumption and efficiency is not statistically significant, suggesting barriers to digitalization’s effectiveness. Our analysis underscores the importance of considering sector-specific dynamics in understanding the relationship between digitalization and energy use.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2007-2020年欧盟28国数字化与最终能源和电力消费的关系，发现数字化增加10%与能源消费减少0.74%、电力消费减少0.47%相关，在工业和居民部门效果显著，但在交通部门不显著。

detail.title: On the Expansion of Rosenblatt Transform
detail.abstract: This paper highlights a useful expansion of the well-known transformation of Rosenblatt [1952, Annals of Mathematical Statistics 23(3), 470-472]. In particular, the paper proves that the statistical properties of a transformed sequence are fully preserved even when the conditional information in the standard Rosenblatt transform is arbitrarily expanded. Because conventional economic wisdom holds that an empirical observation is driven by a broader information set, the expanded transformation generalizes both the statistical theories and real-world applications in several lines of econometric literature. Additionally, the paper highlights useful empirical applications of the novel result in other areas of statistics.

title: User Behaviour Assessment by Predicting Appliance Energy Consumption with Uncertainty Awareness
affiliations: Universidad de Alcalá, Universidad de Alcalá, Universidad Rey Juan Carlos and University of Alcala

detail.title: User Behaviour Assessment by Predicting Appliance Energy Consumption with Uncertainty Awareness
detail.abstract: User behaviour assessment is crucial for monitoring daily routines, particularly for older adults living independently, who often exhibit consistent and predictable activity patterns. Daily activities, such as meal preparation and household maintenance, are closely linked to appliance usage, which serves as a measurable indicator of cognitive and functional status. Deviations from established usage patterns can signal early functional decline or cognitive impairment, enabling timely clinical interventions. Predictive modelling techniques analyse and forecast appliance usage patterns from historical consumption data to generate individualised forecasts, establishing a baseline for each individual. Comparing predicted and actual usage quantifies daily deviations, highlighting inconsistencies that may indicate emerging cognitive or functional issues. Building on these principles, this work implements a predictive framework combining a Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) model with Deep Evidential Regression (DER) to model appliance usage. The approach estimates both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty, improving interpretability and providing confidence measures for each prediction and a principled mechanism to capture deviations from actual usage using a statistical criterion. Deviations from expected usage are identified using an event-based comparison and summarised as a daily score per appliance, accompanied by uncertainty indexes reflecting the model’s confidence. Results indicate that the proposed methodology achieves a reasonable overall predictive performance, while also underscoring the inherent challenges in modelling irregular behaviours compared to more consistent usage patterns. Despite these challenges, the derived daily deviation score, together with the respective uncertainty indexes, proves effective as a complementary tool, providing clear and visually interpretable indicators of behavioural deviations.

title: The Fold Principle: A Universal Pattern from Cosmos to Cognition

detail.title: The Fold Principle: A Universal Pattern from Cosmos to Cognition
detail.abstract: We propose the Fold Principle: emergent order arises when a loaded symmetry is discontinuously broken and the resulting tension is held rather than immediately dissipated. By holding the tension we mean maintaining incompatible constraints in productive coexistence long enough for the system to discover a higher-dimensional resolution rather than collapsing into one pole. This three-stage motif-charged symmetry → break → held tension-recurs from cosmology to cognition. We provide an operational package that distinguishes productive folds from dissipative structures: (i) a Fold Onset Triplet (spectral-gap opening, intrinsic-dimension contraction, topological stabilization); (ii) a holding functional H quantifying sustained non-equilibrium coexistence; and (iii) compression with synergy. We map this template to (i) symmetry breaking and structure formation in cosmology, (ii) synaptic plasticity and E/I balance in neurobiology, (iii) representation dynamics in AI, and (iv) evolutionary innovation. The framework yields falsifiable predictions, measurement protocols, and design principles for engineering systems that hold tension to cultivate creativity without collapse.

title: The Hidden Cost of Coordination: Labor-Market Effects in Complementary Tourism Services
affiliations: Agricultural University of Athens and Drexel University

detail.title: The Hidden Cost of Coordination: Labor-Market Effects in Complementary Tourism Services
detail.abstract: This paper revisits the canonical result that coordination among suppliers of complementary tourism services--such as accommodation, transport, and local activities--typically raises profits while increasing aggregate output and lowering consumer prices. We introduce a novel mechanism: labor market feedback. When firms share a common labor pool, coordination internalizes a cost externality that can overturn the traditional outcome. Extending the standard Cournot framework for complements to incorporate an upward-sloping labor supply, we show that under tight labor markets, coordination amplifies firms' dual market power in both product and labor markets. This dual power enables firms to restrict output, raise prices and depress wages, even as profits increase. Our findings challenge the established "anticommons'' logic and carry direct implications for destination management and competition policy.

title: Is Corruption always Economically Harmful? Discuss with Reference to Both Theory and Empirical Evidence

detail.title: Is Corruption always Economically Harmful? Discuss with Reference to Both Theory and Empirical Evidence

contentType.other: Submitted to the Marshall Society Essay Competition 2025 (the Economics Society of the University of Cambridge)

publicationDetails.detailsText: Marshall Society Essay Competition 2025 (the Economics Society of the University of Cambridge).

detail.abstract: This essay interrogates whether corruption is always economically harmful by integrating theory with country evidence from Russia and Kenya. It frames the debate through the “grease vs. sand the wheels” hypothesis: in inefficient, over-centralized bureaucracies, corruption may temporarily expedite decisions and transactions (“grease”), whereas in most contexts it distorts incentives, entrenches inefficiency, and deters investment (“sand”). The analysis presents Russia as a “sand” case, where grand political corruption—illustrated by the Abramovich–Berezovsky dispute and the post-Soviet oligarchic capture of state assets—undermined legal transparency and predictability, coinciding with volatile FDI dynamics and broader investor wariness. By contrast, Kenya exemplifies limited “grease,” where petty, routinized bribe payments (e.g., in the matatu transport sector) have informally accelerated permits and bypassed bottlenecks, supporting urban mobility and avoiding deeper productivity disruptions amid modest, resilient post-2015 FDI inflows. A simple growth framework with bribe–regulation interaction terms formalizes the conditional effects: bribery’s apparent benefits diminish or reverse as regulatory quality improves. Overall, the essay concludes that corruption is not invariably harmful in the short run; however, any benefits are contingent, narrow, and typically emerge only within already weak institutions, while systemic, grand corruption reliably erodes competition, transparency, and long-run growth.

detail.abstract: The best accident is the one that never happened. The best health care and best long-term care is the one that is not needed, because prevention prevented it. In social policy today, preventative approaches and goals are rare, and if mostly resort to lip service and lofty ideas, without concrete (actual) measures and consequences, without professional top priority given, without systemic applications, and without systematic, comprehensive and constant implementation. Prevention is feasible and the future of social policy depends on preventative social policy to take the lead, i.e. not to replace curative social policy, but to build the first track of social policy, besides curative social policy. Most modern mass diseases, as we know (should know) today, are preventable the very most part for the very most people (at least strongly delayable and reduceable). We have all sorts of workable (financeable, operable, and politically fully realistic) options to successfully, comprehensively, fully effectively and efficiently, and most important in a fully humane and decent manner, conduct preventative social policy. The political will will be there, once if the social policy awareness, practice and goals have been established and disseminated, accepted and wholeheartedly and continuously applied. Up to 90 percent (and more) of a great deal of modern mass diseases, the silent pandemics, are preventable if people start prevent them early in their lives and comprehensively, accumulating good healthy foods, drinks, exercise, happiness, sleep, social support, and buy preventing (avoiding) negative unhealthy foods and sugary/alcoholic drinks (including tobacco consumption), sedentary lifestyles, overweight, unhappiness, loneliness, social/cultural/economic/financial exclusion, etc. Hence, preventative health policy must become the mainstay of preventative social policy.

title: Remittances and Economic Growth: What is the Relationship between Remittance Inflows and Nepal’s GDP Growth between 2000 and 2025?

detail.title: Remittances and Economic Growth: What is the Relationship between Remittance Inflows and Nepal’s GDP Growth between 2000 and 2025?
detail.abstract: This paper looks at the connection between Nepal's economic growth from 2000 to 2024 and remittance inflows. Remittances have grown to be one of the main drivers of Nepal's GDP, giving millions of families financial security while posing significant long-term sustainability concerns. The study examines patterns in remittances, GDP growth, inflation, and poverty alleviation using secondary data from the World Bank, Nepal Rastra Bank, and other government sources. The findings indicate that decreasing poverty rates and consistent economic growth, particularly in the years after 2010, have been closely associated with increasing remittance inflows. The results also indicate that the advantages of remittances might not always be fully translated into sustainable development or profitable investment. They raise living standards and assist families in meeting basic needs, but they also run the risk of causing dependency and driving up inflation. The study comes to the conclusion that while remittances are still essential for maintaining stability in the short term, their long-term worth is determined by how well they are allocated to domestic investment and job creation.

detail.title: The Role of Copyright in Protecting Digital Content in Nigeria: Challenges and Prospects
detail.abstract: The digital revolution has redefined how creative works are produced, distributed, and consumed in Nigeria. It has expanded opportunities for Nigerian creators to reach global audiences, unfortunately it has also exposed their works to piracy, unauthorized reproduction, and economic exploitation. This article examines the role of copyright in protecting digital content within evolving cultural economy in Nigeria. It provides an overview of the Copyright Act 2022, which modernizes the legal framework by addressing online infringement and aligning domestic law with international treaties. The article further analyzes the persistent challenges to protection including rampant piracy, weak enforcement, anonymity in digital spaces, high litigation costs, and cross-border violations  while highlighting opportunities such as technological innovations, streaming platforms, public awareness campaigns, and international collaboration. It argues that effective copyright enforcement is essential not only for safeguarding creators’ rights but also for fostering innovation, cultural identity, and sustainable economic growth in Nigeria’s creative industries.

title: Economic Security of an Integration Association

detail.title: Economic Security of an Integration Association
detail.abstract:
To define the concept of "economic security of an integration association", such categories as "national security" and "national economic security" were consistently considered. When analyzing the category of national security, traditional approaches to its classification, formed back in the 1980s in Western scientific discourse, were analyzed in detail: military; environmental; economic; social; political; informational. 

Having analyzed a large number of official documents regulating national economic security in Russia and other countries, the author reveals that under the influence of a geopolitical and economic situation, approaches to economic security and threats can change dramatically. The author managed to establish seven most common criteria of economic security, which remain relevant regardless of a country or political situation: 1) the ability of the economy to function in the mode of expanded production; 2) the size of the public debt; 3) competitiveness of the economy; 4) food security; 5) stability of the financial system; 6) energy security; 7) socio-political stability.

The analysis of the theory and practice of ensuring economic security within the framework of integration associations and in the context of close international cooperation allowed the author to give his own definition of the economic security of an integration association, as a set of conditions created within the framework of intraregional international cooperation, affecting the provision or increase of the level of national economic security of the member states, in the part where national interests match.

detail.abstract: Lots have been written about the nationalist and anti-immigrant turn of centrist social democratic parties in Europe, and perhaps particularly the case of Denmark. The standard account suggests that the Danish Social Democratic Party has increasingly turned to the right to stem and reverse voters turning to more recent nationalist right-wing parties such as the Danish Peoples Party and others. Hence, the social democrats has itself increasingly come to be perceived as a right-wing party, pursuing an immigration policy that is nationalist in orientation to beat right-wing parties that have positioned themselves as a new kind of xenophobic social democrats. This article questions the underlying premises of this standard account and presents instead an empirically more accurate analysis of the relationships between the Danish Social Democratic Party, the welfare state, nationalism and immigration policy. We argue, first and foremost, that the Social Democratic Party has always been nationalist in orientation. This nationalism was fundamental to the construction of the welfare state and led the party to pursue a consistent strategy of welfare protectionism in the context of asylum and immigration. The only novelties observed is that this long governing party has made this approach increasingly explicit in their political rhetoric, and gradually shifted from a national consensus orientation towards actively setting the agenda when it comes to developing Danish asylum and immigration policy.

detail.title: Crisis Regimes and Contagion Networks: A Computational Integration of Volatility and Systemic Risk Modeling
detail.abstract: Conventional approaches in financial econometrics have traditionally modeled volatility dynamics and systemic risk in isolation, resulting in fragmented analytical frameworks. This study bridges this gap by developing an integrated empirical framework that unifies range-based volatility forecasting, regime-switching analysis, Extreme Value Theory, and systemic network diagnostics. Applying this framework to the Global Financial Crisis (GFC) and the COVID-19 pandemic reveals fundamentally different crisis patterns: the GFC is characterized by endogenous persistence and a hub-and-spoke contagion structure, whereas COVID-19 is characterized by exogenous velocity and a reflexive, densely interconnected risk topology. A core finding is the quantification of significant procyclical shortfalls in Value-at-Risk-based regulatory capital, which systematically underestimated tail risk in both crises. Methodologically, the framework offers a computational early-warning system, demonstrating that Hawkes process-driven structural break clusters provide a 5-to-10-day lead indicator of regime transition. These results necessitate a fundamental transition from static capital adequacy standards toward dynamic, state-contingent regulatory reserves.

detail.abstract: This chapter interrogates the persistent devaluation of Jamaican women’s humanity through the state’s criminalization of abortion and its wider implications for reproductive health and rights. Anchored in the ethical pillars of harm, help, and heal, it blends legal analysis, economic evidence, and rich qualitative narratives—from focus group discussions (2013) and Abortion Monologues stories (2021)—to reveal how restrictive colonial‐era laws perpetuate physical, psychological, and socio-economic harm. Drawing on Jamaica’s 2023 Reproductive Health Survey and the Caribbean Policy Research Institute’s 2021 study, the chapter exposes the connections between unintended pregnancy, intimate partner violence, unsafe abortion, and intergenerational poverty. It critiques the Charter of Fundamental Rights and Freedoms (2011) and Section 72 of the 1864 Offences Against the Person Act, showing how constitutional protections of the foetus entrench gender inequality and obstruct evidence-based public health planning. The author argues that moving “from harm to help and healing” requires legal reform to guarantee safe, accessible, and affordable abortion services; comprehensive, secular sex education; trauma-informed counselling; and policies that integrate reproductive rights into broader economic and social development strategies. Honouring the humanity of Jamaican women demands that the state dismantle the colonial and religious legacies that criminalize their reproductive autonomy and commit to a framework of justice, care, and healing.

publicationDetails.detailsText: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 813

detail.abstract: In this paper, we conduct the first systematic empirical analysis of income inequality in the People’s Republic of China (PRC) at the provincial level. Using data from the China Household Finance Survey (CHFS) and a semiparametric distribution model, we estimate Gini indices for a set of provincial-level administrative units in 2012, 2014, 2016, and 2018. We find that differences in the “prices” and “quantities” of human capital are important factors in explaining differences in inequality between these provincial areas. Our findings suggest that poor areas are highly disadvantaged compared with rich ones, as they face higher income and educational inequality, as well as higher returns to education, while at the same time exhibiting lower average educational attainment. We conclude that filling existing interprovincial human capital gaps and accelerating labor market integration through appropriate government policies could reduce spatial disparities in inequality levels across regions and overall income inequality in the PRC.

title: Can BRICS be considered an Integration Association?

detail.title: Can BRICS be considered an Integration Association?
detail.abstract:
To answer the question of whether BRICS can be considered as an integration association, the author examines in detail the history of the creation and formation of BRICS. Particular attention was paid to the reasons for the evolution from a theoretical concept to full-fledged international economic cooperation, designed to increase the overall level of economic security of the participating countries. 

The author proposed five criteria that an association must meet in order to be considered as an established integration bloc. These include the reciprocal nature of dependence; stability of economic and political ties; a high degree of interaction between national economic structures; a sufficient level of synchronization of national production processes; the inseparability of economic ties.

Further, the author applies mentioned criteria of integration to the practice of international cooperation of the BRICS countries. For this purpose, the author considered official statistical data illustrating the results of cooperation in these five areas. The analysis showed that two of the five criteria fully correspond (the mutual nature of dependence and the stability of economic and political ties), and three correspond to a high degree (a high degree of interaction between national economic structures; a sufficient level of synchronization of national production processes; the continuity of economic ties and the irreversibility of the integration process). association of a new type.

AI.tldr: 本文通过提出五个整合标准来评估BRICS是否构成一个整合联盟，分析显示BRICS在相互依赖性和稳定性方面完全符合标准，在其他三个标准上高度符合，因此可被视为新型整合联盟。

AI.method: 应用五个整合标准分析BRICS国家的国际合作实践，使用官方统计数据评估五个领域的合作成果。

AI.theory_contributions: 建立了评估国际组织整合程度的五个标准框架，为分析新型整合联盟提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 证实BRICS可被视为新型整合联盟，为成员国政策制定和未来合作方向提供了实践指导。

title: A Simulation–Optimization Framework for Efficient Hospital Bed Allocation in Public Health Systems

detail.title: A Simulation–Optimization Framework for Efficient Hospital Bed Allocation in Public Health Systems
detail.abstract: In this paper, we develop a model for the bed allocation problem under Indonesia’s National Health Insurance Scheme (BPJS-JKN). This scheme categorizes patients and beds into three insurance classes. A significant challenge in this scheme is that patients often face bed shortages in their designated classes causing them to be treated in higher class beds or blocked and referred to another hospital. To optimize bed allocation in each class, we develop an overflow queueing model with repacking: when a patient arrives and finds all beds in their treatment class occupied, according to the BPJS-JKN, the patient is treated in the first higher class bed and returned immediately to their original class as soon as such a bed becomes available. We prove that we can use the product form result from the overflow loss network model, enabling the calculation of performance measures of the fractions of blocked patients and overflow patients. Using these measures, we formulate an optimization model to determine the optimal number of beds allocated in each class which maximizes hospital profitability. The performance measures are estimated using Harvey-Hills method which results in an unbiased estimator and the optimization is solved using simulated annealing to fasten the exploration of the solution space, i.e., all possible bed configurations. We apply our model to a use case inspired by the Academic Hospital of Universitas Gadjah Mada in Yogyakarta, Indonesia.
